translations.source_quote: 東京の西のはずれで、住宅地のすぐ隣に畑があります
translations.text: On the western edge of Tokyo, the field sits right next to a residential neighborhood.

translations.source_quote: 親の代からきゅうり一筋で、私で三代目です
translations.text: Since my parents' generation it has been cucumbers and nothing else; I am the third generation.

translations.source_quote: 朝は五時に畑に出て、車の音が増える前に収穫を終えます
translations.text: I go out to the field at five in the morning and finish harvesting before the traffic picks up.
translations.title_text: Harvest at five in the morning

translations.source_quote: 朝と夕方、土の表面が乾く前に水をやります
translations.source_reason_quote: きゅうりは九割が水なので
translations.text: Morning and evening, I water before the surface of the soil dries out.
translations.reason_text: Because a cucumber is nine-tenths water.

translations.source_quote: 葉が混みすぎたら下の葉を落として、風を通します
translations.text: When the leaves get too crowded, I take off the lower ones to let the wind through.

translations.source_quote: 長さが二十センチになったら、その朝のうちに採ります
translations.source_reason_quote: 半日おくと太りすぎて、種が大きくなるからです
translations.text: Once they reach twenty centimeters, I pick them that same morning.
translations.reason_text: Left half a day longer, they grow too thick and the seeds get big.

translations.source_quote: 採るときは必ずはさみで、へたを少し残します
translations.text: I always pick with scissors, leaving a little of the stem.

translations.source_quote: まずは丸ごと一本、塩だけでかじってください
translations.text: First, bite into a whole one with nothing but salt.

translations.source_quote: ぱりっとして、青い香りがします
切るなら、たたいて割ると味がよくしみます
translations.text: If you cut it, smash it and break it apart instead; the flavor soaks in better.

translations.source_quote: ごま油と塩とにんにくで和えるのが、うちの定番です
translations.text: Tossed with sesame oil, salt and garlic: that is the standard at our house.

translations.source_quote: 採ったその日のきゅうりは、においからちがいます
translations.text: A cucumber picked that same day is different from the smell onward.

translations.source_quote: 朝五時の畑の空気を、ひと口でも思い出してもらえたらうれしいです
translations.text: I would be glad if even one bite brought back the air of the field at five in the morning.
translations.title_text: To the one who receives this letter
